description: A standardized CLI wrapper for Uni-Mol molecular ML workflows that handles representation extraction (embeddings), model training (regression/classification), and property prediction with built-in RDKit SMILES validation. USE WHEN you need to generate molecular embeddings, train machine learning models for chemical properties, or run predictions on SMILES datasets (.csv/.smi) using the Uni-Mol framework.
